Innovation is in our DNA… is it in yours?

Bombardier is a global leader in aviation, creating innovative and game-changing planes. Our products and services provide world-class experiences that set new standards in passenger comfort, energy efficiency, reliability and safety. We are a global organization focused on working together with a team spirit.

Your boarding pass will include… 

Several conferences, including:



- Meet An Executive
- Meet a Specialist
- Meet a Pilot
- Women Taking Flight


Learning more about Bombardier, including:



- Aircraft 101 conference
- Bombardier Products conference 
- Visits of the Bombardier sites 
- Bombardier Academy of Learning 


Many social/networking opportunities, including:



- Interns’ committee 
- Volunteering 
- Internal Case Competition
- 5 à 7, Potluck, and much more!


What are your contributions to the team?



- You are currently enrolled in the 3rd or 4th year of an undergraduate university program in an Engineering discipline.
- You bring strong programming and development foundations in Python, SQL, React, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Git.
- You are experienced with the Microsoft Office Suite and capable of utilizing modern digital productivity tools. 
- You are detail-oriented, professional, and able to thrive collaboratively as a team player in a dynamic environment. 
- You possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English. 


How to thrive in this role?



- Design and deploy full-stack web applications and internal tools using React, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS to support smart factory initiatives and manufacturing operations.
- Engineer backend automation scripts and data integration pipelines with Python and SQL, leveraging operational data to drive real-time insights and transformation on the shop floor.
- Build custom internal applications and management tools that streamline communication and workflows across cross-functional engineering teams.
- Assist with strategic software and digital transformation initiatives associated with advanced aircraft programs such as the Global 8000 and 55/6500. 
- Explore research on emerging software architectures and AI applications relevant to manufacturing operations, helping provide technical insights for upcoming pilot projects. 
- Prepare governance materials, technical documentation, and project updates for operational improvement projects reviewed by senior management.


Boarding Information:



- Location: Global 7500/8000
- Duration: 12 months
- Flexible workplace-Hybrid


It is important to note that our internship opportunities are open to students only, not new graduates. The base salary for this position is expected to range from CAD $17.95 to CAD $31.00 per hour. The applicable base salary will be determined based on various criteria, at Bombardier’s sole discretion, such as the candidate’s skills, experience and qualifications. All our interns may be required to occasionally travel outside of Canada for training/work purpose.

Bombardier is a global leader in aviation, creating innovative and game-changing planes. What are your contributions to the team?



-  Participate in the design, development, and documentation of web applications.
-  Contribute to the enhancement and maintenance of existing applications (web and desktop).
-  Collaborate with users and team members to understand business needs and help develop appropriate solutions.
-  Assist in the extraction, import, processing, and documentation of data.
-  Support the team in the development, testing, and deployment of new tools and features.
-  Contribute to the team's continuous improvement initiatives.
-  Participate in providing technical support to system users and help resolve application issues.
-  Perform testing activities and help ensure the quality of developed solutions.


How to thrive in this role?



-  You are currently enrolled in a college or university program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
-  You have a strong interest in web application development and maintenance.
-  You possess basic knowledge of web development technologies:
-  Front-end: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, or similar technologies.
-  Back-end: C#, .NET or .NET Core, and relational databases (SQL Server or equivalent).
-  You are eager to learn new programming languages, tools, and technologies.
-  You have strong analytical skills and a focus on delivering high-quality results.
-  You are recognized as a team player who is curious, open to learning, and enjoys collaborating with others.
-  You demonstrate initiative, autonomy, and attention to detail in the execution of your tasks.
-  Knowledge of SharePoint, Microsoft Power Platform, or Azure services is considered an asset.
-  You are able to communicate effectively in both French and English, verbally and in writing.


Boarding Information:



- Location: Administrative Centre (CA)
- Duration: 8 months
- Flexible workplace-Hybrid


It is important to note that our internship opportunities are open to students only, not new graduates. All our interns may be required to occasionally travel outside of Canada for training/work purpose.
